ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows triangle RST, with vertex R on the left, S at the upper right, and T at the lower right. Side RS is labeled 3x+2, and side RT is labeled 2x+4. There is an identical pink tick mark on each of RS and RT, indicating that these two sides are congruent. Reasoning: Because the tick marks on RS and RT are the same, RS = RT. According to the labels in the diagram, 3x+2 = 2x+4. Solving gives x = 2. RT is required, and RT = 2x+4, so RT = 2(2)+4 = 8.
